text:
That was a mistake, and the game knew it.

On the next sweep, the ninth lamp was closer. Not by much. Maybe one boat length. But the other eight had stayed exactly where they were, and this one had moved toward the pier against the wind.

I wrote it in the log anyway. Nine. The pencil in the game writes slowly, one letter at a time. When it finished, it crossed my nine out by itself and wrote eight above it, in a different handwriting. Smaller. Neater. Somebody older.

So I started reading the log from the beginning.
